title two players
========
OBJECTS
========

black

blue
Wall
grey
PlayerL
white
PlayerR
yellow
Crate
orange
Gem
green
=======
LEGEND
=======
. = Background
# = Wall
L = PlayerL
R = PlayerR
* = Crate
O = Target
G = Gem
Player = PlayerL or PlayerR
=======
SOUNDS
=======
================
COLLISIONLAYERS
================
Background
Target
PlayerL, PlayerR, Wall, Crate
Gem
======
RULES
======
[ > Player | Crate ] -> [ > Player | > Crate ]
[ left PlayerR ] -> [ left PlayerL ]
[ right PlayerL ] -> [ right PlayerR ]
==============
WINCONDITIONS
==============
All Target on Crate
